supportPolicy.description: Each Azure Local release is supported for six months (180 days) after it first became available. endOfSupportDate is derived from firstAvailabilityDate.

features.title: Azure Government Arizona region expansion
features.summary: You can now deploy and manage Azure Local deployments using the US Gov Arizona region, providing an additional Azure Government region beyond US Gov Virginia with support up to Impact Level 5 (IL5).

features.title: Rack aware clusters with SAN
features.summary: Rack aware clusters now support disaggregated SAN deployments, enabling workload protection across two rooms with synchronized storage replication and independent compute and storage management.

features.title: Disk witness for SAN deployments
features.summary: You can now configure disk witness for SAN deployments directly in the Azure portal deployment wizard, helping enable rack aware clusters with SAN.

features.title: Composed ISO refresh cadence
features.summary: Composed ISO releases now follow a semiannual cadence aligned with OEM validation and release cycles.

features.title: Provisioned Machine resources
features.summary: Starting with this release, the Azure portal automatically creates a Provisioned Machine resource for each Azure Arc-enabled server in an Azure Local cluster, using the same resource name. These resources are created…

features.title: Automatic backup of system-level secrets
features.summary: With this release, you can automatically back up system-level secrets, such as Trusted Launch virtual machine keys, BitLocker recovery keys, and other sensitive information, to an Azure Key Vault instance that serves as…

features.title: Local Identity with Azure Key Vault
features.summary: Internal DNS (preview) : In this release, you can deploy Azure Local by using Local Identity with internal DNS.

features.title: Azure Local VMs
features.summary: Graceful VM shutdown : The Azure portal now provides Shut down (recommended) and Turn off options for Azure Local VMs. Shut down gracefully powers down the guest operating system before turning off the VM, while Turn…

features.title: Azure Arc Site Manager
features.summary: View and manage Azure Local VMs across sites from a centralized Azure Arc Site Manager experience, with Kubernetes cluster support also available.

features.title: Add node via Azure portal
features.summary: You can now add nodes to an existing Azure Local cluster directly from the Azure portal with a new guided scale-out experience.

features.title: Update workflow changes
features.summary: This release introduces the prepare updates workflow, allowing you to prepare updates now and install them at a later time.

features.title: GPU Management from Azure
features.summary: Manage and monitor GPU resources in Azure Local from Azure, including centralized GPU inventory, partition configuration, GPU assignment to workloads, and lifecycle management of GPU-accelerated workloads.

features.title: Azure Local VMs
features.summary: DNS server and gateway appliances for workloads can be deployed as Azure Local VMs (GA) : You can now assign Azure Local VMs the DNS server or gateway IP address of a workload logical network. This capability enables…

features.title: Full file system location displayed for storage paths
features.summary: The storage path property now displays the complete file system location, including the GUID folder, for both existing and new storage paths. This change helps you see exactly where workloads are placed.

features.title: New built-in roles for Azure Local migrations
features.summary: Azure Migrate introduces new Azure role-based access control (RBAC) roles that provide purpose-built access for configuring, performing, and monitoring Azure Local migrations.

features.title: Terraform support for replication and migration
features.summary: You can now use Terraform to replicate and migrate VMs to Azure Local through Azure Migrate. This feature is currently in preview.

features.title: SAN integration using iSCSI is now generally available (GA) for hyperconverged deployment
features.summary: You can now integrate external storage area network (SAN) storage from supported vendors with Azure Local using Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI), in addition to Fibre Channel (FC).

features.title: GPU metrics
features.summary: You can now monitor GPU metrics in Azure Local for GPUs configured using GPU Partitioning (GPU-P).

features.title: AKS enabled by Azure Arc changes
features.summary: This release supports the following Kubernetes versions: 1.31.12, 1.31.13, 1.32.8, 1.32.9, 1.33.4, 1.33.5. Kubernetes version 1.30 is no longer supported.

features.title: Disaggregated deployments for Azure Local
features.summary: Starting with this release, you can deploy Azure Local using Storage Area Network (SAN) storage only. This architecture enables independent scaling of storage and compute, allowing clusters to scale beyond 16 nodes.

features.title: SAN support for Azure Local
features.summary: SAN storage is now generally available for Azure Local. You can attach SAN storage and use it alongside Storage Spaces Direct.

features.title: Local identity with Key Vault
features.summary: Starting with this release, local identity with Key Vault is generally available.

features.title: Manage update settings for Azure Local
features.summary: Starting with this release, you can control how updates are applied to Azure Local.

features.title: Improved Secure Boot Certificate readiness
features.summary: Starting with this release, Azure Local orchestrates Secure Boot 2023 certificate update. This process helps you deploy protection for CVE-2023-24932 while minimizing risk during updates.

features.title: Simplified machine provisioning
features.summary: Starting with this release, use simplified machine provisioning to install the OS and register your Azure Local machines together in a single streamlined process.

features.title: AKS enabled by Azure Arc changes

features.summary: Starting with this release, the update workflow from the Azure portal now provides richer, more detailed information.

features.title: End of Windows Server Subscription and Extended Security Updates (ESU) purchases for OS version 20349.xxxx (22H2)
features.summary: If running OS version 20349.xxxx (version 22H2), you can no longer purchase Windows Server Subscription or ESU.

features.title: Drift detection
features.summary: Starting with this release, the drift detection framework identifies configuration deviations, improves troubleshooting, and helps reduce configuration-related issues in your Azure Local environment.

features.summary: Starting with 2601 release, you can connect to Windows and Linux based Azure Local VMs that don't have network connectivity or have boot failures.

features.title: Unique ID for data disks
features.summary: In 2601 release, you can identify data disks on your Azure Local instance with a new property called Unique ID . The unique ID matches the UniqueId of the data disk ( Get-Disk | Select-Object UniqueId ).

features.summary: You can now collect diagnostics logs directly from the Azure portal to help with support investigations. This change eliminates the need to manually gather logs from individual nodes.
